_meta.validation_notes: Questions and options are in Spanish; why is concise English feedback. Each contrast_form changes only target morphology and reverses the keyed option. Source viewpoints and correct labels are stored in a frozen, deterministically de-patterned order; labels are 25/25 overall, cross-balanced by source viewpoint, nonperiodic, and never run more than three times consecutively.
